WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id<900 THEN r.net_sales END) AS stores_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN r.net_sales END) AS web_net, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.net_sales<>0 THEN r.store_id END) AS stores_active
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.calendar_date

SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n999, MIN(sale_date) mn, MAX(sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key)
WHERE (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-06-30') OR (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-24')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0, MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line
WHERE (return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') OR (return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22')
